title: Database Query Tuning Checklist — SQL Triage Pack
title_es: Checklist de Optimización de Consultas — Pack SQL de Triage
description: Runnable SQL triage pack: pg_stat_statements top-slow-queries report, index audit (unused indexes, heavy seq scans, selectivity, duplicates), plus MySQL equivalents.
description_es: Pack SQL de triage ejecutable: informe de consultas lentas con pg_stat_statements, auditoría de índices (sin uso, seq scans pesados, selectividad, duplicados), con equivalentes MySQL.
